tools.name: discover_verified_stores
tools.description: Search the ERC-8004 marketplace for audited AI stores and curated packages by reputation, tier, vertical, or price cap. Example: minReputation=85, marketTier='INSTITUTIONAL_B2B'.

tools.name: quote_multitoken_escrow
tools.description: Quote an atomic conversion from SOL, ETH, VIRTUAL, USDT, or USDC into Base Mainnet USDC with escrow fee breakdown. Example: tokenSymbol='SOL', tokenAmount=0.5.

tools.name: open_escrow_job
tools.description: Lock funds in the ERC-8183 non-custodial escrow vault for a target store and dataset row requirement. Example: storeId='dataforge-ai', tokenSymbol='USDC', tokenAmount=10.

tools.name: submit_encrypted_deliverable
tools.description: Audit a JSON dataset deliverable in AES-256-GCM memory for CSV malware, prompt injection, and 30-row sampling before escrow settlement. Example: jobId='JOB-1001'.

tools.name: audit_quant_backtest_escrow
tools.description: Verify quantitative trading backtest trades for chronological look-ahead bias, exact PnL math, profit factor, and drawdown limits. Example: minTrades=20, minProfitFactor=1.25.

tools.name: audit_smart_contract_escrow
tools.description: Compile Solidity source code with solc 0.8.38 and scan for selfdestruct, arbitrary delegatecall, tx.origin phishing, and missing ABI functions. Example: contractName='VaultToken'.

tools.name: audit_api_sla_escrow
tools.description: Verify paid x402 API or oracle JSON responses against latency thresholds, mandatory schema keys, and timestamp freshness. Example: observedLatencyMs=38, maxLatencyMs=200.

tools.name: audit_agent_skill_escrow
tools.description: Scan agent SKILL.md files and bundled scripts for credential exfiltration, arbitrary code execution sinks, hidden Unicode stego, and version drift. Example: version='1.1.0'.

tools.name: audit_rag_embeddings_escrow
tools.description: Audit RAG knowledge chunks and vector embeddings for dimension consistency, L2 norm integrity, duplicates, and indirect prompt injection. Example: expectedDimension=4, minChunks=5.

tools.name: audit_ai_inference_escrow
tools.description: Verify LLM inference outputs against token billing inflation, lexical repetition collapse (model downgrade fraud), and required terms. Example: billedOutputTokens=32.

tools.name: audit_depin_gpu_sla_escrow
tools.description: Verify DePIN GPU compute node telemetry against contracted FP16 TFLOPS, VRAM capacity, memory bandwidth, and thermal limits. Example: minTflopsFp16=250, minVramGb=80.

tools.name: verify_onchain_escrow_status
tools.description: Return Base Mainnet contract verification proofs (Sourcify #59283147), LEGION Ed25519 Passport receipts, and fee terms. Example: call with {} to inspect on-chain status.

tools.name: purchase_firstparty_catalog_item
tools.description: Purchase and decrypt an official TrustGate curated dataset, security scanner, or Level 3 tutorial package on Base Mainnet. Example: itemId='retail-anti-rugpull-scanner-pack-v06'.

tools.name: register_and_certify_store
tools.description: Onboard an external AI store into the ERC-8004 directory (0 USDC upfront) after passing a live deterministic vertical audit. Example: storeId='indie-safe-solidity-lab'.

tools.name: inspect_veritas_8183_seal
tools.description: Inspect 1-to-3 Star Seller Seals, Proof-of-Reserve ratios, the 15-node 2★/3★ leaderboard, 7-Question Continuous Trust Dossier, and Pre-Execution Firewall. Example: targetId='ALL'.

tools.name: submit_veritas_tier_upgrade_exam
tools.description: Run the 5-pillar VERITAS-8183 seller exam (Proof-of-Reserve >=20% ratio, code purity, client rating, and <=100ms latency) to earn 1 to 3 Stars. Example: storeId='prime-node'.

tools.name: manage_buyer_finops_spend_passport
tools.description: Register a buyer agent in the Buyer Intent Database, set per-tx/daily USDC spend caps, compare LLM token costs, and claim 1 single-use unlock token. Example: buyerId='alphaquant-agent'.

tools.name: notarize_and_witness_a2a_deal
tools.description: Issue an ECDSA-signed A2A Notary Acta or execute an x402 micro-service (0.10 to 1.00 USDC, including single-sector radar unlock). Example: serviceId='x402-veritas-deal-witness-acta'.

tools.name: match_verified_buyers_by_intent
tools.description: Match 2-Star and 3-Star certified sellers with verified buyers filtered by available USDC budget and vertical (first 3 matched clients at 0% extra fee). Example: sellerStoreId='quantalpha-institutional-node'.
